items.title: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Joins Pentagon Push To Scale Military Drone Production
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) is working with General Motors under the Pentagon's Project Agincourt to scale US military drone production. The Pentagon initiative is enlisting large automotive manufacturers to apply high volume assembly methods to unmanned aerial system manufacturing. Project Agincourt is intended to increase the output of drones for US forces by tapping existing automotive supply chains and plants.
